name: INPUT_MODE_LIVE
meaning: normal play: Input_Poll latches both pads

name: INPUT_MODE_RECORD
meaning: pad recording: Input_SetMode snapshots the remap into the .PAD header. Never entered: no caller passes 1

name: INPUT_MODE_PLAYBACK
meaning: set by PadRec_Load; Input_Poll stops latching (the playback step is missing from this build)
